objects.name: Analytic 2120
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a write to a Siemens project file path on a Linux engineering workstation from a User Identifier (UID) not associated with the Siemens engineering tool runtime. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.
